_comment: Parameter-domain scope planning, replayed by _shared/lua/test/config_scope_plan_contract.lua on macOS and Linux. entry points: scope_inventory(scope, {actions = <function answering the stored action_parameters paths>}, owners) and scope_plan(scope, mode, paths, owners) of the manifest reader, where owners.action_parameter_domain(path) answers the domain of a path "action_parameters.<domain>__<binding>__<action>" (the domain is one of gesture, keyboard, script, tap_key, tap_hold) only when <binding> is lowercase letters, digits and single underscores, never starting or ending with one, and <action> is a generated action that declares a parameter; otherwise it answers nothing. inventories: for each scope, the stored paths below and the number of paths the scope owns (inventory_count); for both modes "clear" and "recommended" the plan deletes exactly the inventory's paths as action_parameters rows (delete = true, no value). refusals: each path, given alone to scope_inventory and scope_plan of the gestures scope, makes both refuse (raise).

drivers.windows: Not ported: one AHK consumer calls the Windows manifest reader's scope inventory and plan with an owner built from the generated action catalogue.
